commitments.detail: Oxygen package approved for home use.
Stationary concentrator and portable pouch will be provided.
Training on delivery and usage will be conducted within 7 days.
Oxygen equipment will be delivered within 2 days.
Patient will receive training on the use of stationary and portable oxygen equipment.
Install stationary oxygen equipment as needed and provide portable oxygen for mobility.
Provide training on the use and maintenance of both stationary and portable oxygen equipment.
Stationary and portable oxygen equipment will be delivered within 2 business days.
Training on the use of stationary and portable oxygen equipment will be provided.
